scalars.scalar_value: Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible leadership experience in communications, member communications, patient communications, customer communications, healthcare communications, public affairs, marketing, or related disciplines.

items.item_text: Bachelors degree required
Advanced degree preferred.

Minimum fifteen (15) years of progressively responsible leadership experience in communications, member communications, patient communications, customer communications, healthcare communications, public affairs, marketing, or related disciplines.
Healthcare experience strongly preferred.
Significant experience working with healthcare operations, care delivery organizations, customer experience functions, quality organizations, physician groups, or health plans.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and cross-functional initiatives.
Experience working in highly regulated environments required
Strong understanding of healthcare delivery systems, member experience, quality improvement, reputation management, and customer engagement.
Member, Care Delivery & Quality Communications Strategy
Develop and lead Kaiser Permanentes enterprise member, care delivery, and quality communications strategy.
Ensure communications support organizational priorities, care delivery objectives, quality goals, member experience priorities, reputation strategies, and business objectives.
Establish enterprise standards, governance, messaging frameworks, and best practices for member-facing communications.
Serve as the enterprise expert on member communications, care delivery communications, quality communications, and member trust strategies.
Build enterprise capabilities that strengthen communication effectiveness across the member journey.
Care Delivery & Operational Communications
Serve as the primary communications partner to care delivery leadership and operational teams on member-facing communications strategies and materials.
Develop communication strategies supporting operational initiatives, service changes, facility openings, care delivery enhancements, quality initiatives, and member experience improvements.
Advise care delivery leaders on communication approaches related to operational challenges, service disruptions, access issues, care delivery changes, and other member-facing concerns.

Lead communications planning for initiatives such as hospital openings, medical office building openings, urgent care expansions, service changes, care delivery transformations, and operational improvements.
Develop member communications approaches that support operational goals while protecting member trust and organizational reputation.
Lead communications planning and execution for member-facing aspects of operational incidents, service interruptions, emergency response situations, and crisis events.
Medical Foundation & Care Delivery Communications
Provide executive leadership for Medical Foundation Communications teams and care delivery communications resources supporting Kaiser Permanentes Colorado, Washington markets.

Serve as a key communications partner to Permanente Medical Group leadership, care delivery executives, and market communications leaders to support communications strategies related to clinical excellence, care delivery transformation, physician engagement, quality initiatives, operational priorities, and member experience.

Ensure communications strategies are coordinated across health plan, hospital, medical group, quality, customer experience, and operational stakeholders in support of Kaiser Permanentes integrated care and coverage model.

Serve as the communications leader responsible for connecting care delivery strategy, member experience, quality performance, operational priorities, and organizational goals into a coordinated communications approach.
Share best practices, communications tools, messaging frameworks, governance models, and lessons learned across markets to strengthen care delivery communications capabilities enterprise-wide.

Serve as a strategic advisor to care delivery leaders on communications approaches related to operational initiatives, member experience, quality performance, clinical priorities, physician engagement, and organizational change.
Quality Communications & Health Observances

Partner with Quality leaders, Permanente Medical Groups, and Care Delivery leaders to communicate quality performance, patient safety initiatives, preventive health priorities, clinical innovations, and care delivery improvements.
Develop communication strategies that support quality outcomes, preventive care, patient engagement, and trust in Kaiser Permanentes care delivery system.
Lead enterprise planning, coordination, and communications strategies for health observances, clinical awareness campaigns, and care delivery engagement initiatives.

Partner with Quality, Care Delivery, Permanente Medical Groups, Marketing, Community Health, and Communications leaders to establish annual health observance priorities and integrated campaign strategies.
Ensure Kaiser Permanente leverages health observances to advance prevention, screening, quality outcomes, member engagement, and community health objectives.
Coordinate content development, member-facing communications, clinician communications, earned media opportunities, digital engagement, and stakeholder outreach associated with health observances.
Member Communications Governance, Channels & Enablement
Establish enterprise governance, standards, decision rights, and approval processes for member and care delivery communications.
Develop and maintain enterprise playbooks, messaging frameworks, templates, toolkits, FAQs, and communications resources that enable consistent execution across markets.

Define enterprise channel strategies and standards for member-facing communications, including letters, email, SMS, app notifications, digital platforms, call center communications, and emerging channels.
Clarify roles, responsibilities, escalation pathways, and approval processes between enterprise functions, markets, care delivery leaders, legal, regulatory affairs, and customer experience teams.
Enable markets with adaptable communications resources that maintain enterprise consistency while supporting local operational, regulatory, and business requirements.
Member Messaging & Content Strategy

Oversee development of member-facing communications including letters, emails, service recovery communications, patient education materials, talking points, FAQs, signage, scripts, and other member communications.
Serve as the enterprise owner for member-facing messaging standards, content governance, and communication quality.
Develop member-facing messaging related to care delivery changes, service interruptions, access issues, operational updates, quality initiatives, and other significant member experiences.
Prepare and distribute communications guidance and talking points for physicians, care teams, call centers, operational leaders, and frontline staff.
Coordinate messaging across enterprise and market stakeholders, including clinical leaders, operational teams, legal, regulatory, customer experience, and communications partners.
Establish editorial standards and quality controls for member-facing content.
Call Center & Service Communications
Oversee enterprise communications standards, scripting strategies, and messaging frameworks for member-facing call center interactions.

Partner with Customer Experience, Operations, Care Delivery, and Contact Center leaders to ensure call center scripts, member messaging, and service communications are accurate, consistent, empathetic, and aligned with enterprise priorities.
Develop communications approaches that support service recovery, operational changes, quality initiatives, care delivery updates, and other member-facing issues requiring contact center engagement.
Ensure frontline teams have access to timely messaging, FAQs, talking points, and communications resources needed to support positive member experiences.
Service Recovery & Operational Readiness
Lead member communications strategies related to service recovery, operational challenges, and member experience issues.

Establish scenario-based communications playbooks, holding statements, FAQs, and member impact frameworks for common operational disruptions, access issues, service interruptions, and care delivery challenges.
Maintain operating rhythms with care delivery, quality, customer experience, and operational leaders to proactively identify emerging member issues and communications needs.
Partner with Customer Experience, Quality, Operations, and Care Delivery leaders to improve transparency, understanding, and member trust during periods of disruption or change.
Member Journey & Experience Integration

Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Experience, Care Delivery, Quality, and Digital leaders to create a seamless communications experience across the member lifecycle-from acquisition and onboarding through care delivery, retention, and loyalty.

Ensure member-facing communications support a coordinated and consistent experience across marketing, enrollment, onboarding, care delivery, service interactions, digital channels, and member support functions.
Serve as the Public Affairs leader responsible for ensuring communications strategies reinforce trust, understanding, engagement, and loyalty throughout the member journey.
Identify opportunities to simplify communications, reduce member confusion, improve transparency, and strengthen the overall member experience.
Integrated Member Campaigns
Partner with Marketing leaders to develop integrated member-facing campaigns that support care delivery priorities, quality initiatives, preventive health goals, and member engagement objectives.
Collaborate with Customer Experience, Quality, Community Health, and Care Delivery leaders to create coordinated approaches to member engagement and health improvement.
Lead communications planning for enterprise member outreach initiatives and care delivery campaigns.
Ensure communications strategies complement broader marketing, brand, and customer engagement efforts.
Market Integration & One KP Execution
Partner with Market Public Affairs Leaders to ensure consistent execution of member and care delivery communications strategies across markets while allowing for appropriate local adaptation.
Establish governance, planning processes, content standards, and operating models that enable enterprise member communications strategies to be effectively executed across all markets.
Provide markets with tools, templates, messaging frameworks, and communications resources that support consistent member experiences and One KP standards.
Maintain visibility into market-specific member communications challenges, operational issues, and emerging concerns to inform enterprise planning and decision-making.
In-Facility & Digital Communications
Oversee member-facing communications across physical and digital care environments.
Establish standards and governance for facility signage, digital screens, patient information materials, waiting room communications, and other member-facing communications.
Ensure member-facing materials meet brand, accessibility, readability, and communication standards.
Partner with operational leaders to ensure consistent communications experiences across care settings.
Governance, Measurement & Operational Excellence
Lead governance processes for member-facing communications requiring enterprise review and approval.
Coordinate review processes involving communications, legal, regulatory, clinical, operational, customer experience, and executive stakeholders.
Build and continuously improve a scalable enterprise member communications operating model that supports consistency, speed, quality, compliance, and market flexibility.
Develop measurement frameworks that assess member understanding, engagement, sentiment, trust, communication effectiveness, and service recovery outcomes.
Partner with Digital, Customer Experience, and Marketing leaders to advance modern communications capabilities and improve the member communications experience.
Demonstrated success leading member, patient, customer, consumer, care delivery, or quality communications strategies.
